decision_space.eligible_tensor: transfer-produced tensor with two or more adjacent transfers
decision_space.concrete_assignment: one compatible staging placement and one path choice for every adjacent transfer
decision_space.nondegenerate_tensor: concrete assignment domain size greater than one
decision_space.placement_nondegenerate: more than one compatible staging placement
decision_space.path_nondegenerate: more than one compatible adjacent-path tuple for at least one fixed placement
decision_space.naive_space: cartesian product of eligible tensor assignment domains; reported only as a census, not as a coupling claim

classification.PASS: every workload has a nondegenerate tensor and the frozen portfolio contains an independent path choice
classification.NARROW: some nondegenerate tensor opportunity exists, but a workload has none or all variation is placement-only
classification.FAIL: the frozen portfolio contains no nondegenerate tensor
